title: Luscious Chimichurri Rump
subtitle: with sweet potato wedges & a feta and tomato salad
description: Pesto Princess chimichurri brings notes of coriander, parsley, and chilli to already flavourful beef rump. Served with roast sweet potato and a tossed salad of cucumber, leaves, marinated tomatoes, feta, and sunflower seeds. Delish!

instructions.title: CRISP THE SWEET POTATO
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Spread out the sweet potato wedges on a roasting tray, coat in oil, and season. Roast in the hot oven for 35-40 minutes until cooked through and crisping up, shifting halfway.

instructions.title: PICKLE THE TOMATOES
instructions.text: Place the halved baby tomatoes and the red wine vinegar in a salad bowl. Add a drizzle of oil and some seasoning. Toss to coat and set aside to marinate.

instructions.title: CRUNCHY SEEDS
instructions.text: Place a large, nonstick pan over a medium heat. When hot, toast the sunflower seeds for 2-4 minutes until lightly browned, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: BUTTER-BASTED RUMP
instructions.text: When the wedges have 10 minutes remaining, return the pan to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. Pat the steaks dry with some paper towel. When the pan is hot, sear the steaks fat-side down for 3-5 minutes until crispy. Then, fry each side for 2-4 minutes or until cooked to your preference. (The time this takes will depend on the thickness of the steaks.) During the final 1-2 minutes, baste the steaks with a knob of butter and the Beef Rub to taste. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside to rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

instructions.title: ASSEMBLE THE SALAD
instructions.text: Add the cucumber half-moons and rinsed salad leaves to the bowl of marinated tomatoes. Crumble in the drained feta, toss until coated, and set aside for serving. In a small bowl, loosen the chimichurri with olive oil in 5ml increments until drizzling consistency.

instructions.title: SASSY STEAK SUPPER
instructions.text: Plate the crispy wedges alongside the fragrant beef rump slices. Drizzle the chimichurri over the beef. Serve the fresh salad on the side with a scattering of toasted sunflower seeds. Time for your taste buds to tango!

chef_tip: Sweet potatoes are rich in fibre, which stabilises digestion and nutrient absorption. This helps to reduce blood sugar spikes and keep you feeling fuller for longer!
